images.description: The design viewer with the Mounting Type menu open and Mounting 1 locked as part of the original design, plus GAD and T BOX page tabs — the parametric surface where engineers assemble a drawing by picking components.
images.altText: Design viewer with mounting-type menu open on a motor drawing

images.description: The export dialog confirming 'This component combination is unique' before offering file export or save to the design library — the visible payoff of SHA-256 fingerprinting that makes duplicate drawings in the catalog structurally impossible.
images.altText: Export dialog confirming the component combination is unique

images.description: The dashboard listing projects and designs as cards, each with an embedded motor drawing preview, quick filters and search — the library command centre where engineers find and open the general arrangement drawings they maintain.
images.altText: Dashboard listing project and design cards with drawing previews

images.description: A finished general arrangement drawing for a 250M frame foot-mounted motor rendered full-bleed in read-only view, with title block, tolerances and dimensioned views — the actual engineering output the tool produces from selected components.
images.altText: Full general arrangement drawing of a foot-mounted motor

images.description: The pages manager showing GAD and T BOX sheets with base drawings attached, plus a drag-and-drop SVG upload area and live preview — how a multi-sheet design is composed before components are customized on top.
images.altText: Pages manager with SVG base-drawing upload and preview

images.description: A project information panel over the drawing showing name, type, category and description with a change-category control — the organizational layer that groups related designs under one project record for a given motor order.
images.altText: Project information panel over an engineering drawing

images.description: The viewer with Mounting 4 selected from the Mounting Type menu, updating the motor drawing to match — demonstrates how choosing a component option re-renders the general arrangement drawing on the fly rather than redrawing by hand.
images.altText: Viewer showing Mounting 4 selected, drawing updated

images.description: A compact single-item variant of the dashboard showing one project with a larger drawing preview and list density controls — illustrates responsive list behaviour, but largely repeats the primary dashboard view above it.
images.altText: Compact dashboard showing a single project item
